name: Sea Breeze Beach House
accommodation: One-bedroom studio with a double bed
beachAccess: About a six-minute walk to Manorbier beach
confirmedFeatures: Kitchenette, en suite shower, wood burner, fibre broadband, TV, walled garden with loungers, portable BBQ, body boards, welcome pack
overview: Sea Breeze is an architect-designed eco studio with a sedum roof in Manorbier village, about six minutes' walk from the beach and three from the castle. It has a double bed, a kitchenette, a wood burner and a private walled garden.
surfTripFit: A walk to the beach and body boards provided make it an easy couple's base for Manorbier.
